_doc: Per-tool annotation-CLASSIFICATION ratchet for story-mcp (rf2-yi451; closed-world list corrected rf2-voux7 finding 4; open-world split rf2-e6knrq finding 2). See the sibling re-frame2-pair-classifications.json _doc for the full rationale. POSTURES: `read-only` = readOnlyHint:true MUST be set + destructiveHint MUST NOT be true; `destructive` = destructiveHint:true MUST be set + readOnlyHint MUST NOT be true (the safety-load-bearing write surface — register-variant / unregister-variant / record-as-variant are the gated `--allow-writes` writers; preview-variant / run-variant execute a variant lifecycle so they carry destructiveHint). OPEN-WORLD SPLIT (rf2-e6knrq finding 2): story-mcp is NOT wholly closed-world. `run-variant` and `preview-variant` run the variant AUTHOR'S lifecycle events/fx through the live re-frame2 dispatch+fx pipeline; Story fx-stubbing (:fx-overrides / :force-fx-stub / :network) is an OPT-IN authoring surface, not a universal default, so an un-stubbed effect fires the REAL handler and CAN reach HTTP/analytics/websocket/storage/navigation/etc. Those two tools therefore carry `:openWorldHint true` (run-variant-annotations in tools/story-mcp/src/re_frame/story_mcp/tools/schemas.cljc) so an agent host applies the appropriate confirmation ceremony instead of treating the call as contained on-box. EVERY OTHER tool stays closed-world (`:openWorldHint false`): the read-only-annotations + destructive-write-annotations defs set false, and that false value rides verbatim onto the live tools/list descriptor. record-as-variant is closed-world by the same logic — it records an externally-driven canvas + an on-box registry write, never running the lifecycle itself. (rf2-voux7 finding 4: the generated manifest's `:annotations` KEY-presence vector lists `openWorldHint` because the key EXISTS on every tool; its VALUE is what this ratchet pins. The `closed-world` list below pins those tools to openWorldHint:false — a flip on any of them, OR a flip of run-variant/preview-variant away from open-world, turns the ratchet RED via this fixture + the JVM annotations-on-every-tool open-world matrix.) Sourced from tools/story-mcp/tool-descriptors.edn — keep in lockstep; one row per tool.
